groups.lede: Lying around the map. No fight needed for most of them.
Key valuables inside illegal operations. Take them while you clear the place.
Handed out or picked up during a main mission.
Rewards from strangers and side contacts.
Bought like any other gun, but each store has its own.

items.name: Assassin Nipper .38
items.where: In a hidden hatch inside a derelict spy boat at the southern tip of the eastern island of the **Permit Keys**, near the military base. Focus mode shows you the hatch. It comes **silenced**, and there's no fight, so it's the easiest one to grab early.

items.name: Turnt Nipper .38
items.where: Hanging from a tree with a crashed ultralight aircraft on the Mariana County coast.

items.name: Crabshack VF5
items.where: At the abandoned research outpost in the Pelican Valley swamp. The safe code is **0072** and the door code **0212**; the SMG is in the locked boathouse.

items.name: Swamp Bait Akulus
items.where: On the floor of a wrecked hunter's cabin in the middle of the Pelican Valley swamp.

items.name: Cruel Huntsman's SM-69
items.where: Outside the same cabin as the Swamp Bait Akulus, on the boardwalk next to some sniper ammo. Get both in one trip.

items.name: Marabunta Grande Hobo
items.where: In a storage building near the Hamlet pawn shop. Follow the screams: a gang is holding the manager inside, and the sawed-off is in a weapon case.

items.name: Couch Potato Mustang .357
items.where: Off **Tanglewood Lane** in Port Gellhorn, where an old couch hangs in a tree. Shoot it down, then sit on it.

items.name: Brontasaurus Bat
items.where: In the batting cages of the abandoned **Dino Golf** in Frogswater.

items.name: Cargo H&L .38
items.where: Inside a yellow shipping container at the north end of the Port Vice City cargo yard. Climb the container stacks to reach it.

items.name: Lyle's H&L .38
items.where: In the trunk of an abandoned car inside an old barn at the end of a road in Bonanza.

items.name: Kingfishers W-22
items.where: In a weapon case in the main shack of the **Fishing Shacks** operation in Wetman Bay.

items.name: Kingfishers Akulus
items.where: In a trailer in the middle of the **Sunrise RV Park** operation by Cottonmouth Lake.

items.name: Kingfishers Laird 350
items.where: At the Kingfishers' run-down **Manatee Motel**, which you can raid in Chapter 1. A bolt-action hunting rifle.

items.name: Gutterball Moreland 850
items.where: On a pool table in the games area of **Kingpin Bowling**. It's one of the three valuables for [Let's Go Bowling](/trophies/lets-go-bowling/).

items.name: Scrapper VF5C
items.where: On the top floor of the **La Cascara Motel** operation in Port Gellhorn.

items.name: Kolt & Associates Vatra
items.where: Inside the **June Warehouse** operation in Port Gellhorn.

items.name: Kolt & Associates 556
items.where: Inside the Kolts' **Stash House** operation. A fully automatic carbine.

items.name: The Guardian ES18
items.where: Part of the haul at the Guardia Brothers' **Saber Shipping Yard** in Little Cuba.

items.name: GRX 556
items.where: Inside the **Leonida Carrier Warehouse** operation in Balsero.

items.name: Donnie's H&L .38
items.where: In the trunk of Donnie's car in **Don Gone** (Chapter 1). Open the trunk before anything happens to the car; once it's gone, so is the gun.

items.name: Gil's Kalinga .50
items.where: Inside the practice safe you steal and crack in **Safe Word**, together with $1,500.

items.name: Bae-Luxe's Bat
items.where: Your reward for finishing **Cooties**, the music video job in Crosstown.

items.name: Roxy's W-10
items.where: One of two SMGs you get for finishing **Photo/Shoot**.

items.name: Bae-Luxe's W-10
items.where: The other SMG from **Photo/Shoot**.

items.name: Francisco's LMG-6
items.where: Lying on the ground during the last fight of **VCIA Takedown**. Pick it up as Jason before you leave, or it's gone.

items.name: Pete's KZ-59
items.where: On the table behind the red door in the hangar at the Sundown Private Airfield, during Pilot Pete's first job, **Passing the Torch** (Chapter 4).

items.name: Mister Mangrove Laird 350
items.where: A tranquilizer rifle Kirk hands you when you board his helicopter in his last job, **Help Kirk Find Mr. Mangrove** (Chapter 2, at night).

items.name: Killtelligence SM-69
items.where: Bret's reward for **Veteran Hunted**, Jason's first hunt in Lummox County (Chapter 2, after Coffee Break), together with $500.

items.name: Mahi Nipper .38
items.where: Sold at **Chuck's Tackle & Shot** in Key Lento.

items.name: Iron & Oak WCR-1
items.where: Sold at **Iron & Oak** in Vice City.

items.name: Backdoor Hobo
items.where: Sold at **Zenon's Pawn Shop** in La Perle.

items.name: Honky Tonk Mustang .357
items.where: Sold at **Phil's Ammu-Nation** in Southside.

items.name: Duval Signature ES9
items.where: Comes with the **Ultimate Edition**. Edition weapons wait in the weapon locker at any Ammu-Nation.

src.label: PC Gamer: Best unique weapons to grab early in GTA 6
src.note: Read Nov 25, 2026 (published Nov 24). Trusted. 127 weapon variants in Menu > Progress > Weapons > Variants. Assassin Nipper .38 (spy craft cache, south tip of eastern Permit Keys island near military base, Focus Mode, suppressor, no combat), Kingfishers Laird 350 (Chapter 1 Kingfisher hideout, no silencer). Only the first ~40k characters came through verbatim; Scrapper VF5C at La Cascara Motel top floor verbatim; Kolt & Associates 556 (Kolt stash house, near the pill safe, full auto, no suppressor) and the gold map icon came from the fetch summary and are only used where Detonated agrees.

src.label: Detonated: All GTA 6 Unique Weapon Variant Locations
src.note: Read Nov 25, 2026 (updated Nov 20). 127 variants + 2 Ultimate Edition extras, 123 listed by class with how to get. Illegal operation names match PowerPyx's gang operations list. Used only where a second independent source agrees (or for counts PC Gamer confirms). /all-127-weapon-variant-locations/ refused the fetch.

src.label: Output Lag: GTA 6 Unique Weapons, Every Gold Gun Location
src.note: Read Nov 25, 2026 (updated Nov 22). 9 free finds with codes (Crabshack 0072/0212), Donnie's missable, gold name and icon, can't be modified, recover from any Ammu-Nation weapon locker or the vehicle trunk loadout. Disagrees with Detonated on Conspiracist Type 9 and Turnt Nipper details (Turnt kept at coast + crashed ultralight in a tree, which both say).

src.label: Screen Rant: GTA 6 All Unique Weapons & Where To Find Them
src.note: Read Nov 25, 2026 (Nov 23). 28 weapons. The Game Haus (Nov 23) has the same table row for row, so the two count as one source. Single-source details left out: Guardian ES18 safe code 8046, Gil's Kalinga (we use PowerPyx's Safe Word), Pete's KZ-59 Jason/Ch 4 (we use PowerPyx), Bae-Luxe's W-10 location, Jack Sheep(e) H&L .38 (spelling and edition status differ), Ride Free H&L .38 (Screen Rant east of Ambrosia vs Detonated Leonard County), Mahi Nipper price ($1,160 vs Space4games $1,044).

src.label: Space4games: GTA 6 All Unique Weapons
src.note: Read Nov 25, 2026 (modified Nov 24). 12 rows from own play: Marabunta Grande Hobo (Hamlet Storage, gang holding the manager), Gutterball, Scrapper, Brontasaurus Bat (spelling agrees with Detonated; Screen Rant writes Buntosaurus), Mahi Nipper at Chuck's, Crabshack codes, Kingfishers Akulus, Kolt & Associates Vatra (June warehouse). Stats table not used (6cheats says no stat advantage found). Final Chapter KVGA-12 left out: Space4games says Moses's Western Nightblade job, Detonated says Irons Building Supply.

src.label: AltChar: GTA 6 All Unique Weapons and their Locations
src.note: Read Nov 25, 2026 (modified Nov 25). Names and types by region only; says 102 total but lists 68. Used as a name/region cross-check, not for locations.

src.note: Read Nov 25, 2026 (Nov 21). Aggregates Output Lag, KeenGamer, Game Rant and Detonated (its store table matches Detonated), so not counted as independent.
